entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable! I've been on hold for ten minutes! I need to return these garbage shoes right now!
Thank you for holding. My name is David, and I can help you with that. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
It's John Sterling, order 788-B45. And I'm telling you, these so-called premium cycling shoes are the worst I have ever owned. It's false advertising!

Okay, Mr. Sterling, I have your order pulled up. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?

A preference? Do I have a 'preference' for pain? The shoes have given me horrible blisters on both heels! I've adjusted the cleats ten times, I've tried different insoles, nothing works. They're defective!
I see. Getting blisters from new shoes is certainly frustrating, and I understand why you'd want to return them. I just need to check the return eligibility for you.
Don't give me the runaround! I want a full refund, and I want it now! If I don't get it, I'm lighting you up with bad reviews everywhere. Put your manager on the phone!
I understand you're upset, and I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. Let me just take a quick look at your purchase date. One moment.
Okay, Mr. Sterling, I see that you received the cycling shoes 68 days ago. Our company policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days.
So? What's your point? Are you going to help me or not?
My point is that you are well within the timeframe for a return. I can absolutely approve this for a full refund. I am emailing you a pre-paid return label as we speak.
Oh. So... you're just... approving it? I just print the label and send them back?
That's exactly right. Once our warehouse receives the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. The email should be in your inbox now.
Well... okay then. That's what I wanted. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
